heading: Security Incident Notification
text: The Service Provider shall report any confirmed unauthorized access to customer data to the Primary Contact, with notice not to be exceeded by forty-eight (48) hours following discovery.

heading: Insurance Threshold
text: Vendor agrees to maintain a floor of USD 3,000,000 in general commercial cyber risk insurance throughout the active engagement period.

heading: Agreement Effective Date
text: This Master Services Framework will take full legal effect starting October 15, 2025.

heading: Service Response and Remediation
text: For Priority 1 System Outages, initial technical acknowledgement must occur within 1 hour, and complete resolution is mandated within 12 hours of initial triage.

heading: Payment Timelines
text: Customer shall remit payment for all undisputed line items within a deadline not to exceed 60 days from invoice generation.

heading: Termination Date
text: Unless extended by mutual written amendment, this agreement automatically terminates on December 31, 2028.

heading: Secondary Incident Handling
text: For Major System Vulnerabilities, incident response is required within 6 hours, while full patch application must be concluded in under 72 hours.

heading: Minimum Coverage Requirement
text: Contractor must maintain at least USD 10,000,000 in professional liability coverage to handle enterprise infrastructure operations.

heading: User Privilege Audits
text: System administrators must conduct comprehensive user access reviews and permission recertifications every 180 days.

heading: Late Payment Interest
text: Invoices unpaid after the due date shall accumulate finance charges of 1.5% per month or the maximum statutory rate allowed by law.

heading: Breach Cure Window
text: In the event of a non-monetary material default, the non-breaching party may grant a 30-day cure period prior to initiating contract cancellation.

heading: Data Backup Frequency
text: Database snapshots and full system backups must be executed every 12 hours and stored in offsite redundant data centers.
